items.title: Make proof-or-stop-* the canonical agent role IDs and keep lattice-* readable
items.context: Follow docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-agent-prompt-consolidation-execution-plan.md M0.5: canonical IDs are proof-or-stop-implementer, proof-or-stop-review-*, proof-or-stop-evaluator, and the four currently unprefixed roles. Normalize read/gate choke points (REVIEW_RUN_LANES, isReviewerAgent, init-check required agents, quorum) so existing lattice-* evidence still counts. New review_run_start / finding_add / review_pass_set / init_check_set writes must use canonical IDs only.
items.userSees: User sees `"proof-or-stop-review-quality"` in reviewer_list output, and a legacy `"lattice-review-quality"` record is reported as a compatible alias.

happy.desc: New proof-or-stop reviewer role IDs are emitted and accepted by review_run_start, review_pass_set, init_check_set, and quorum resolution.

verification.command: node --input-type=module -e "import assert from \"node:assert/strict\"; import {canonicalAgentRoleId} from \"./packages/main/dist.staging/core/agent-role-identity.js\"; assert.equal(canonicalAgentRoleId(\"lattice-review-quality\"),\"proof-or-stop-review-quality\"); console.log(\"CHK-001 canonical role smoke: PASS\")"

edge.desc: Persisted lattice-* role IDs are normalized to the matching proof-or-stop lane without changing their historical evidence bytes.

verification.command: node --input-type=module -e "import assert from \"node:assert/strict\"; import {canonicalAgentRoleId, agentRoleIdsEqual} from \"./packages/main/dist.staging/core/agent-role-identity.js\"; assert.equal(canonicalAgentRoleId(\"lattice-review-quality@fallback\"),\"proof-or-stop-review-quality@fallback\"); assert.equal(agentRoleIdsEqual(\"lattice-review-delivery\",\"proof-or-stop-review-delivery\"),true); console.log(\"CHK-001 legacy suffix smoke: PASS\")"

adversarial.desc: A non-reviewer or malformed role ID cannot be smuggled into a reviewer lane merely by containing the proof-or-stop or lattice prefix.

verification.command: node --input-type=module -e "import assert from \"node:assert/strict\"; import {resolveAgentDispatchType} from \"./packages/main/dist.staging/core/agent-dispatch-registry.js\"; assert.equal(resolveAgentDispatchType(\"verification-intent\").canonicalType,\"proof-or-stop-test-intent\"); assert.throws(()=>resolveAgentDispatchType(\"lattice-review-unknown\"),/unknown agentType/); console.log(\"CHK-001 alias-boundary smoke: PASS\")"

verificationEvidence.command: node --input-type=module -e "import assert from \"node:assert/strict\"; import {canonicalAgentRoleId} from \"./packages/main/dist.staging/core/agent-role-identity.js\"; assert.equal(canonicalAgentRoleId(\"lattice-review-quality\"),\"proof-or-stop-review-quality\"); console.log(\"CHK-001 canonical role smoke: PASS\")"
verificationEvidence.note: Canonical role resolution maps a lattice reviewer input to the proof-or-stop output spelling.

verificationEvidence.note: Legacy role aliases with host suffixes normalize without losing the suffix, and canonical/legacy lane comparison agrees.

items.title: Switch managed-block markers to proof-or-stop start/end with dual-read
items.context: Canonical markers become <!-- proof-or-stop:start --> and <!-- proof-or-stop:end -->. Readers must still locate <!-- lattice:start --> / <!-- lattice:end --> so already-installed CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md blocks are not orphaned. New writes and init --upgrade emit the new markers. Do not leave a one-sided rename that skips existing managed regions.
items.userSees: User sees `"<!-- proof-or-stop:start -->"` and `"<!-- proof-or-stop:end -->"` in a newly initialized file; an upgraded old file has one managed block, not two.

happy.desc: New managed files contain proof-or-stop start and end markers.

verification.command: node --input-type=module -e "import assert from \"node:assert/strict\"; import { inspectManagedBlock, replaceManagedBlock } from \"/private/tmp/proof-or-stop-b5a88-marker-build/core/managed-markers.js\"; import { generateProfileSection } from \"/private/tmp/proof-or-stop-b5a88-marker-build/claude-md-sync.js\"; const legacy=\"before\\n<!-- lattice:start -->\\nold\\n<!-- lattice:end -->\\nafter\\n\"; const replacement=\"<!-- proof-or-stop:start -->\\nnew\\n<!-- proof-or-stop:end -->\"; assert.equal(inspectManagedBlock(legacy,\"document\").status,\"valid\"); assert.match(replaceManagedBlock(legacy,replacement,\"document\"),/<!-- proof-or-stop:start -->/); const profile=generateProfileSection(\"balanced\"); assert.match(profile,/<!-- proof-or-stop-profile:start -->/); assert.equal(inspectManagedBlock(profile,\"profile\").status,\"valid\"); console.log(\"CHK-002-MARKER-PASS\");"

edge.desc: An already-installed lattice managed block is found and replaced in place rather than duplicated or orphaned.

verification.command: node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { inspectManagedBlock, replaceManagedBlock } from '/private/tmp/proof-or-stop-b5a88-marker-build/core/managed-markers.js'; const replacement='<!-- proof-or-stop:start -->\\nnew\\n<!-- proof-or-stop:end -->'; const nested='<!-- lattice:start -->\\n<!-- lattice:start -->\\nold\\n<!-- lattice:end -->\\n<!-- lattice:end -->'; const mixed='<!-- proof-or-stop:start -->\\nold\\n<!-- lattice:end -->'; assert.equal(inspectManagedBlock(nested,'document').status,'malformed'); assert.equal(replaceManagedBlock(nested,replacement,'document'),null); assert.equal(inspectManagedBlock(mixed,'document').status,'malformed'); assert.equal(replaceManagedBlock(mixed,replacement,'document'),null); console.log('CHK-002-MALFORMED-PASS');"

adversarial.desc: A document with mismatched or nested marker pairs is rejected or left unchanged instead of being rewritten destructively.

verification.command: node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import * as assets from '/private/tmp/proof-or-stop-b5a88-init-build/init-assets.js'; const names=['AGENTS_MD_TEMPLATE','LATTICE_MD_TEMPLATE','CLAUDE_MD_TEMPLATE','LATTICE_DOT_DIR_MD_TEMPLATE','AGENTS_MD_GLOBAL_THIN_TEMPLATE']; for (const name of names) { const value=assets[name]; assert.match(value,/<!-- proof-or-stop:start -->/); assert.match(value,/<!-- proof-or-stop:end -->/); assert.doesNotMatch(value,/<!-- lattice:start -->|<!-- lattice:end -->/); } console.log('CHK-002-TEMPLATE-PASS');"

items.title: Write new artifact schemas as proof-or-stop.* while still accepting lattice.*
items.context: Persisted schema literals such as lattice.done-required-evidence.v1 and lattice.closeout_write_receipt.v3 stay readable. New writes use the same suffix with a proof-or-stop. prefix. Do not rewrite archived story JSON in place; that would change historical bytes and signatures. Centralize the prefix so gates and residue scans cannot drift.
items.userSees: User sees `"schemaVersion": "proof-or-stop.done_required_evidence.v1"` in new evidence, while story_get reports an archived `"lattice.done_required_evidence.v1"` artifact as valid.

happy.desc: Every in-scope new artifact writer emits the proof-or-stop prefix for its schema while preserving the existing suffix and version.

edge.desc: Readers accept the corresponding lattice-prefixed artifact schema and continue validating its existing integrity and freshness fields.

adversarial.desc: An unknown prefix, suffix, or version is rejected and archived story JSON is never rewritten as part of the migration.

verificationEvidence.note: Canonical proof-or-stop command-spec and closeout receipt writers were asserted.
Historical lattice v1/v2 command-spec and closeout literals remain readable.
Unknown command-spec and closeout schema literals fail closed without rewriting.

items.title: Move the remote-push-approval schema to a proof-or-stop literal with hook dual-read
items.context: Writer in core/release-push-approval.ts and consumer in .githooks/pre-push currently require lattice.remote-push-approval.v1 exactly. New approvals must write a proof-or-stop.remote-push-approval.v1 schema. The hook and CLI must accept both during the window; a one-sided rename blocks git push origin main. Keep the one-shot consume semantics.
items.userSees: User sees `"schema": "proof-or-stop.remote-push-approval.v1"` after release_approve_push, then pre-push reports `"one-shot remote publish approval consumed"`.

happy.desc: A new release approval is written with proof-or-stop.remote-push-approval.v1 and is accepted by the hook.

edge.desc: A valid lattice.remote-push-approval.v1 approval remains readable during the compatibility window.

adversarial.desc: The same approval cannot be consumed twice, and an invalid or stale approval is rejected without disabling the hook.

items.title: Rename the root npm package from lattice to proof-or-stop
items.context: Root package.json and both lockfiles currently name the workspace lattice. Change the publish identity to proof-or-stop, keep versions in sync with LATTICE_CLI_VERSION / PROOF_OR_STOP_CLI_VERSION, and update any self-host detection that keys on the root name. This is a registry-identity change; do not leave package.json and lockfile split.
items.userSees: User sees `npm pkg get name` return `"proof-or-stop"` and `proof-or-stop --version` print `"Proof-or-Stop <version>"`.

happy.desc: The root package.json and package-lock.json use proof-or-stop as the workspace name and stay synchronized with the CLI version constants.

edge.desc: Existing self-host detection accepts the canonical root/package identity and does not silently bypass its safety gate.

adversarial.desc: A split package/lockfile name or version is detected by the identity verification path before publish or install.

items.title: Rename sibling packages @lattice/utils and @lattice/lab to @proof-or-stop scoped names
items.context: B-cc10 moved only @lattice/core. Update packages/utils and packages/lab package names, their lockfiles, and every in-repo import/dependency to @proof-or-stop/utils and @proof-or-stop/lab. Widen any remaining exact-name consumers the same way pre-push already accepts both core names.
items.userSees: User sees `npm pkg get name --workspace=packages/utils` return `"@proof-or-stop/utils"` and the lab entrypoint resolve `"@proof-or-stop/lab"`.

happy.desc: Sibling package metadata, lockfiles, and in-repo dependency references consistently use @proof-or-stop/utils and @proof-or-stop/lab.

edge.desc: The global lab entrypoint resolves canonical sibling packages alongside the already migrated @proof-or-stop/core package.

adversarial.desc: No exact-name consumer leaves a mixed package graph that resolves an old sibling name while metadata claims the new scope.

items.title: Remove the leftover npm bin alias named lattice
items.context: B-cc10 deleted bin/lattice.js but packages/main/package.json still maps bin.lattice to dist/cli.js. Remove that alias so npm no longer installs a lattice command. Keep bin.proof-or-stop. Update help, residue scans, and hooks that still treat lattice as a supported invocation after the alias is gone.
items.userSees: User sees the package bin list contain `"proof-or-stop"` and not `"lattice"`, and help no longer prints `"Usage: lattice ..."`.

happy.desc: The main package bin map contains proof-or-stop and omits lattice, while the canonical help and entrypoint checks pass.

edge.desc: Residue scanning distinguishes frozen historical evidence and compatibility readers from unsupported new lattice command aliases.

adversarial.desc: A reintroduced lattice bin alias or help invocation fails the verification path rather than being silently accepted.
